# Single source of truth for paths that autonomous workflows may never change.
# Read by .github/scripts/check-protected.py from origin/main (never from the proposed change),
# and used by claude.yml (claude-fix), shell-repair.yml and self-sculpt.yml.
# Matching (case-insensitive):
#   entry ending in "/"            -> every path under that directory
#   entry without "/"              -> matches that file name at ANY depth (globs allowed)
#   entry containing "/" (no end /) -> matches that exact repo-relative path (globs allowed)
# Categories:
#   1. control plane: workflows, hooks, submodule config
#   2. dependency control: manifests and lockfiles (a changed manifest runs code at install time)
#   3. build/lint/test configs: these EXECUTE during `npm run build`, `eslint` and `vitest`
#   4. Guardian and tool-dispatch code
#   5. foundation, engine and the licence

.githooks/

package.json
